Title: How to Halve a Recipe: Half of 3/4 Cup, 1/3 Cup, 1 Tbsp
Description: Half of 3/4 cup is 1/3 cup + 2 tsp. Half of 1/3 cup is 2 tbsp + 2 tsp. Half of 1/4 cup is 2 tbsp, and half of 1 tbsp is 1 1/2 tsp. The free printable kitchen chart also covers thirds, 1 1/2 times, doubles, cups to mL, grams, and oven temperatures.

Title: How Many Tablespoons in a Cup? (Free Kitchen Conversion Chart)
Description: 1 cup is 16 tbsp, 3/4 cup is 12 tbsp, 1/3 cup is 5 tbsp + 1 tsp, and 1/4 cup is 4 tbsp. The free printable kitchen chart also converts cups and spoons to fluid ounces and mL, grams to ounces, and oven temperatures.

Title: Oven Temperature Conversion: 350°F to °C and More
Description: 325°F is 163°C, 350°F is 177°C, 375°F is 191°C, 400°F is 204°C, and 425°F is 218°C. The free printable kitchen chart covers 250-475°F plus cups to mL, grams to ounces, and halving or doubling a recipe.

Title: Cups to mL: How Many Milliliters in a Cup? (Free Chart)
Description: 1 cup (US) is 237 mL, 1/2 cup is 118 mL, 1/4 cup is 59 mL, 1 tablespoon is 15 mL, and 1 teaspoon is 4.9 mL (NIST SP 811). The free printable kitchen chart also covers grams to ounces, oven temperatures, and halving or doubling a recipe.

Title: How to Make One Third of a Recipe (Cups and Spoons)
Description: One third of 1 cup is 1/3 cup, of 3/4 cup is 1/4 cup, of 1/2 cup is 2 tbsp + 2 tsp, of 1/4 cup is 1 tbsp + 1 tsp, and of 1 tbsp is 1 tsp. The free printable kitchen chart also covers halving, 1 1/2 times, and doubling.
